This is the Flask 3.1.3 security fix release, which fixes a security issue but does not otherwise change behavior and should not result in breaking changes compared to the latest feature release. PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/Flask/3.1.3/ Changes: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-3-1-3 The session is marked as accessed for operations that only access the keys but not the values, such as in and len . GHSA-68rp-wp8r-4726
